inj.note: A rookie fifth-round pick out of Clemson, Randall is still waiting to make his NFL debut while he's spent all season on IR due to a neck injury. He had his 21-day evaluation window opened Oct. 28 and has been a full participant in practices each of the last three weeks, but the Ravens haven't elected to reinstate him. His window will come to a close Wednesday, so if he's not activated by then, the 22-year-old running back will remain on IR for the rest of the season.
